topic: Burnout recovery: why rest is not the whole answer (carousel)
caption:
Tired again by Wednesday after a break? That may say less about how you rested than you think.

Burnout is described as the result of chronic workplace stress that has not been well managed. In studies of healthy workers, the lift from a holiday eased back in the weeks after returning to work. So recovery is often about what keeps draining you, as well as how much you rest.
